rationale: v1.80.1 already has marker tap_confirm, direct information-card entity toggles and clickable lock-information badges. Its card rows bypass configured confirmation and its badge lacks keyboard parity. This restores safe consistent operation and access in existing stable functionality, not an intermediate-release feature repair.

summary.ru: Подтверждение учитывается в карточках устройств; сведения о замке доступны с клавиатуры.
summary.en: Device-card toggles respect confirmation; lock information is keyboard-accessible.
